composites.name: cell-sorting-with-viz
composites.description: CompuCell3D cell-sorting demo with a wired Visualization Step. Each update produces a Plotly HTML figure of the running scalar trajectories, written to the 'viz_html' store.

mcs_per_step.description: Fallback MCS count if interval rounds down to zero.

viz_title.description: Title displayed at the top of the Plotly figure.

composites.name: cell-sorting-demo
composites.description: Tiny CompuCell3D cell-sorting demo: a small two-type blob driven by differential adhesion. Emits cell counts, average volume/surface, and MCS each update.

interval.description: PBG interval per update (MCS count). The CC3DSimService advances this many Monte Carlo Steps per Process.update().

mcs_per_step.description: Fallback MCS count if interval rounds down to zero.
